location_description: Corvallis ( kor-VAL-iss) is a city and the county seat of Benton County in central western Oregon, United States. It is the principal city of the Corvallis, Oregon Metropolitan Statistical Area, which encompasses all of Benton County.  As of the 2020 United States Census, the population was 59,922.
